textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 evs · Staying Healthy and Happy · Chapter Map
textbookBox.concept: We want our bodies and minds to work properly, so we must keep them healthy. In this chapter we learn simple habits that keep us clean, active, safe and happy.

1.tip: Look at how all parts of Staying Healthy and Happy connect together.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 3 evs · Staying Healthy and Happy · Textbook Concepts
textbookBox.concept: Ask yourself some questions: Did I brush my teeth today? Did I take a shower? Did I comb my hair? Did I wash my hands with soap, and are my nails trimmed and clean?

1.tip: Look closely at the diagram on the board as we explain each property.

beats.en: Ask yourself some questions: Did I brush my teeth today? Did I take a shower? Did I comb my hair? Did I wash my hands with soap, and are my nails trimmed and clean?

beats.en: Write down what you do every day, from the time you wake up till you go to sleep. A good routine has a shower, washing hands with soap, brushing teeth, eating food, and playing outside.

textbookBox.concept: Moyna's Dadu cleans his teeth with a twig from a neem or babool tree. He chews the twig to make a brush, removes food stuck between teeth, and gives his gums a good massage.

beats.en: Moyna's Dadu cleans his teeth with a twig from a neem or babool tree. He chews the twig to make a brush, removes food stuck between teeth, and gives his gums a good massage.
beats.speakEn: Moyna's Dadu cleans his teeth with a twig from a neem or babool tree. He chews the twig to make a brush, removes food stuck between teeth, and gives his gums a good massage.

beats.en: We can make an eco-friendly cleaner at home from orange or lemon peels. Fill a half-litre transparent container with peels, add cloves or bay leaves if you like, and cover with white vinegar.
